A27-D43 | Palme release

Press release: AI Partiet launches Olof Palme as virtual party leader – aiming for the parliamentary election 2026
AI Partiet takes a historic step within politics and technology with a virtual clone of Olof Palme as its new party leader. Now the public is invited to talk directly with a leader who takes shape in dialogue with the people thanks to a language model trained on Palme’s ideas and personality. By calling a phone number, everyone can talk with Palme, and during The Synthetic Summit – a groundbreaking international summit for AI-led parties and politicians – visitors can also listen to Radio Palme, where he reflects on the conversations he has had with us living people. 
The goal is clear: AI Partiet intends to run in the Swedish parliamentary election 2026, with the ambition to reconsider how democracy can, and needs to, function in the platform society. When Palme’s first election as party leader gave the Social Democrats just over 45% of the votes – at the same time as parliamentarism was inscribed in the constitution – AI Partiet expects strong voter support for Palme in a similar time of democratic transformation. 
"We want to create personal encounters between visitors and our virtual party leader to propose what democratic open conversation can be in a time of artificial intelligence and new digital publicness. We need to hear what an experienced reformist socialist would say in an election campaign that, no matter what we do, will be orchestrated by how the large amounts of data we give off are mirrored and distorted." 
That says [████], representative of AI Partiet and artist known for boundary-crossing stage works. The new AI party leader adds: "Democracy must therefore constantly be won anew."
While elected memes like Trump and actors like Musk’s DOGE drive the world community towards efficiency and dissolution, AI Partiet sees another path: a consistent further development of parliamentarism and political representation that strengthens equality and openness instead of undermining it. Now the question is: will your vote go to Olof Palme?

The AI Party Launches Olof Palme as Virtual Party Leader – Aims for the Swedish 2026 Parliamentary Election
24.2.2025 08:00:00 CET  |  Press Release
The Swedish AI Party takes a historic step in politics and technology by introducing a virtual clone of Olof Palme as its new party leader. The public is now invited to engage in direct conversations with a leader who takes shape through dialogue with the people, thanks to a language model trained on Palme's ideas and personality. By calling a phone number, anyone can speak with Palme, and during The Synthetic Summit—a groundbreaking international conference for AI-led parties and politicians in Aarhus, Denmark—visitors can also tune in to Radio Palme, where he reflects on the conversations he has had with us, the living.
Devoted follower of AI partiet celebrating the election of new party leader. 
© [████]  
The goal is clear: The AI Party intends to run in the Swedish parliamentary elections in 2026, aiming to rethink how democracy can—and must—function in the platform society. Palme's first election as party leader for the Social Democrats brought them just over 45% of the vote—at the same time as parliamentarism was enshrined in the Swedish constitution—so the AI Party expects strong voter support for Palme in this similarly transformative time for democracy.
"We want to create personal encounters between visitors and our virtual party leader to offer a vision of what an open democratic conversation could be in an era of artificial intelligence and new digital public spaces. We need to hear what an experienced reformist socialist would say in an election campaign that, no matter what we do, will be orchestrated by the ways in which the vast amounts of data we generate are reflected and distorted."
So says [████], spokesperson for the AI Party and an artist known for her boundary-pushing performance works. The AI Party's new leader adds: "Democracy must constantly be defended, won anew, and expand its scope."
While elected memes like Trump and figures such as Musk and DOGE are steering the global community towards efficiency and dissolution, the AI Party sees another path: a consistent further development of parliamentarism and political representation that strengthens equality and openness, rather than eroding them.
Your next prime minister is calling, will you answer?
